promotionSurvey.run: OH-PROM-O 2026-09-09: property survey of the 12 committed captures against the 5 registered vectors (driver's P4 sweep). No capture was taken (oracle on a moving business date).
promotionSurvey.verdict: Five captures carry no distinct money property to pin (three write echoes with no money cell, two GET templates with no money cell, one empty breach list). Two are byte-identical duplicates of captures that ARE covered (wc-loans-list-raw == loans-list-raw, both sha 2327a39a...; wc-products-list-raw == loan-products-list-raw, both sha ae60eab0...). The remaining uncited capture (the product definition list) carries product-CONFIG values that belong to the loanproduct bounded context, not to a loan/workingcapital money read-back. near-breach-list is empty because the seed configures no breach/delinquency range; the threshold comparison its name suggests is unobservable without a seed change (a fresh capture this run must not take).
